text: dsh-media-preview 是一个面向 DSH 网页客户端的媒体预览插件，会在右侧文档预览中为视频和音频文件注册对应的渲染器，并显示浏览器原生播放器。Host 侧提供支持 HTTP Range 的媒体读取路由，按需分块读取文件；桌面端还可通过本机 loopback 来源支持播放定位。视频可使用倍速、循环、全屏和画中画控制，音频可调整倍速和循环，相关偏好保存在浏览器中。它适合需要在 DSH 文件预览侧栏直接查看或收听常见媒体文件的用户。代码未要求 API key 或外部服务。

dsh-media-preview adds native media players to DSH's document preview. A range route streams file chunks for playback. Video offers speed, loop, full-screen and picture-in-picture; audio offers speed and loop. Preferences stay in the browser. No key or external service is required.
想在 DSH 文件侧栏直接播放视频。
能不能在文档预览里听音频文件？
I want to preview a movie from the DSH file sidebar.
dsh-media-preview 的功能「侧栏媒体播放」：在右侧文档预览中为视频或音频文件显示原生播放器。打开匹配扩展名的文件即可播放，视频和音频分别使用对应播放器并读取文件媒体信息。
dsh-media-preview 的功能「媒体分段传输」：播放器通过支持 HTTP Range 的路由读取本地文件数据，服务器按配置的块大小逐段返回字节范围，让媒体可以按需加载和定位，而不必一次读入整个文件。
dsh-media-preview 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 19 天；提交数 15；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-media-preview README · dsh-media-preview：Video and audio preview for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): play `mp4`, `mov`, `mkv`, `webm` and `mp3`, `flac`, `wav` right inside the right-Sidebar document preview instead of the built-in “this format cannot be previewed” empty state.

**中文** | English (this file) · [中文说明](README.zh.md)

dsh-media-preview README · Why：The built-in preview registers renderers for text, code, Markdown, images, PDF, HTML, Office and spreadsheets, and lists video/audio suffixes as *known binary containers with no renderer* — so opening a video shows an icon and one line of text. This plugin registers those suffixes and draws the browser's native player, fed by an authenticated streaming route that honours HTTP `Range`, so seeking works and a 2 GB file is never loaded into memory or into the conversation.

dsh-media-preview README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-media-preview
```

Then restart the desktop app (a profile patch change is read at boot). No configuration is required; the defaults cover the common suffixes.

To check it loaded, open any `.mp4` from the Files tab: the preview pane shows the player rather than the unsupported-format notice.

dsh-media-preview README · What it does：- **Renderer** — registers two document-previews implementations, `dsh-media-preview/media` (video suffixes) and `dsh-media-preview/audio` (audio suffixes), with priority `extension`, `loading: 'renderer'`, and their suffixes declared binary so the “plain text” fallback is not offered.
- **Player** — a native `<video>`/`<audio>` element with the browser's own controls. The video is fitted into the pane with `object-fit: contain` inside a flexible frame, so a portrait or landscape clip is fully visible at once, with black letterboxing instead of spilling past the preview edge. Below it sit **倍速 / Speed** (cycles 1× → 1.25× → 1.5× → 1.75× → 2× → 0.5× → 0.75×), **循环 / Loop**, and — for video — **全屏 / Full screen** and **画中画 / Picture in picture**. Speed and loop also apply to audio, and the choice is remembered per browser. Audio shows a card with the file name, its size and the player. The body reports `loaded` / `failed` back to the document preview owner so the tab's loading state settles.
- **Stream** — a Host route `GET|HEAD /api/media-preview?path=<absolute path>` that answers `200` with `Accept-Ranges: bytes`, `206` with `Content-Range` f
dsh-media-preview README · Configuration：Settings live on the `media-preview` entry (Settings → Plugins, or the profile patch). Every key has a code-side default, so a partial config is valid.

dsh-media-preview README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Mount the route at all. _Off_ leaves the renderer registered but transfers no bytes (`503`). |
| `routePath` | `/api/media-preview` | Route pathname. Must start with `/api/`; anything else falls back to the default so the auth fence still applies. |
| `loopback` | `true` | Also serve bytes from the token-guarded `127.0.0.1` origin. This is what makes the desktop player seekable. _Off_ keeps only the authenticated route: the desktop shell can play but not seek. |
| `debug` | `false` | Append playback/loopback diagnostics to `$DSH_HOME/media-preview-debug.log`. Leave off unless you are diagnosing a problem. |
| `maxBytes` | `2147483648` (2 GiB) | Largest file served; larger files answer `413`. |
| `chunkBytes` | `1048576` | Bytes per ranged read. |
| `videoExtensions` | `mp4, m4v, mov, webm, ogv, ogg, mkv, avi, wmv, flv, 3gp, ts, m2ts, mts` | Suffixes the video player claims. |
| `audioExtensions` | `mp3, wav, flac, m4a, aac, oga, opus, weba, wma, aiff, aif` | Suffixes the audio player claims. |

dsh-media-preview README · Configuration：The browser half mirrors the suffix lists in `lib/client.js`; keep them in sync when changing either side. The route path is published to the page as `__DSH_MEDIA_PREVIEW_CONFIG__` by the Host, so a configured path and the player's URL never drift apart.

dsh-media-preview README · Playback support：Playback depends on the browser's own codecs, not on this plugin. Chromium/Electron plays MP4 (H.264/AAC), WebM (VP8/VP9/Opus), Ogg and most audio formats. **Matroska (`.mkv`) and AVI usually do not decode** in Chromium; the player then reports “浏览器不支持这个编码 / This codec is not supported by the browser” and the _Open in app_ control in the preview header still hands the file to the system player. Remuxing such files to MP4/WebM is the reliable fix.

dsh-media-preview README · How it is built：```
lib/index.js    Host entry: name / inject / Config / apply (route, loopback origin, index injection)
lib/config.js   Defaults and normalization, no host imports (unit-testable)
lib/schema.js   schemastery Config for the loader/settings page
lib/range.js    HTTP Range interpretation, pure functions

dsh-media-preview README · How it is built：The browser half is a hand-written module-loader bundle (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`) with `react` and `react/jsx-runtime` as its only module-table requests, so it needs no build step and cannot drift from the Host's React copy.

dsh-media-preview README · Development：```sh
node --test test/*.test.js
```

For end-to-end checks, start a host with the plugin installed and run the probe:

```sh
node scripts/e2e-browser.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:<port> --token <token> --video "<absolute path to a video>"
```

`E2E_BROWSER_CHANNEL=msedge` makes Playwright use the system Edge when the bundled Chromium is unavailable.

Seeking has its own check, including the desktop transport shape:

dsh-media-preview README · Development：```sh
node scripts/e2e-seek.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:<port> --token <token> --video "<absolute path to a video>" --simulate-desktop
```

dsh-media-preview README · Known limitations：- One byte window per request; a multi-range `Range` header is answered `416`. Browsers only ever ask a media element for one window.
- `.mkv`, `.avi`, `.wmv`, `.flv` are claimed and listed, but Chromium cannot decode them; the plugin shows the player's error state rather than pretending they play.
- No playlist, subtitle-track or speed controls of its own — the native controls own those.
- If a deployment blocks the loopback origin (firewall, policy), the player falls back to the authenticated route automatically: the file still plays, but the desktop timeline is not seekable again. That is an Electron limitation ([electron#38749](https://github.com/electron/electron/issues/38749), [electron#51442](https://github.com/electron/electron/issues/51442)), not something the route can fix.
